split_definition.method: SHA-256 of canonical raw 53-feature strings; first 8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian modulo 100
split_definition.definition: SHA-256 of canonical raw 53-feature strings; first 8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian modulo 100; train buckets 0-59, calibration 60-79, source_test 80-99

preprocessing.empty_nan_inf_rule: replace with fitted source-train finite median; use 0.0 only if no finite source-train observations

random_forest_disagreement.score: 1 - maximum per-class fraction of the 200 tree predictions

feature_space_distance.scaler: StandardScaler fit only on CIC source-train
feature_space_distance.score: mean distance to the 5 nearest source-train reference rows

split_conformal.calibration: disjoint conformal_quantile_fit subset of CIC source calibration partition
split_conformal.nonconformity: 1 - calibrated probability assigned to the true source-calibration class
split_conformal.quantile: finite-sample split-conformal order statistic at ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))/n
split_conformal.prediction_set: include each binary class whose nonconformity is at or below the frozen calibration quantile

isolation_forest.score: negative sklearn score_samples, higher means more anomalous and more deserving of review

disjoint_subsets.probability_calibration_fit: secondary SHA-256 of the canonical 46-feature float32 vector with fixed domain-separation string source-e1-cal-v1; first 8 digest bytes modulo 100 in 0-49
disjoint_subsets.duplicate_vectors: identical 46-feature vectors remain in the same calibration subpartition

calibration.probability_method: sigmoid/Platt calibration fit on probability_calibration_fit subset only
calibration.conformal_calibration: fit split-conformal quantile on disjoint conformal_quantile_fit subset only, using probabilities from the frozen Platt calibrator

e1_reporting.per_seed: detector metrics, generic-error ranking, attack-miss ranking, calibration, score distributions
e1_reporting.acceptance_rule: Report CIC source-only stability; target transfer remains locked pending project-level interpretation.
e1_reporting.generic_error_endpoint: AUPRC for ranking incorrect source-test predictions as positive events
e1_reporting.stability_numeric_tolerance: not imposed; source-only metrics and across-seed spreads are reported, and target evaluation remains locked pending stability-gate review

distance_execution.definition: For each source-test row, mean Euclidean distance in source-train-standardized 46-feature space to the five nearest original CIC source-train rows.
distance_execution.scaler_fit: All original CIC source-train rows, StandardScaler.partial_fit in 100000-row input-order blocks.
distance_execution.reference_chunk_order: Consecutive source-train input offsets, starting at zero.
distance_execution.duplicate_compression: Within each chunk, np.unique(axis=0, return_counts=True) over finite float32 feature rows; integer multiplicity is retained exactly.
distance_execution.per_chunk_search: Fit one sklearn KDTree on the standardized unique rows and retrieve the five nearest distinct vectors per query.
distance_execution.merge: Merge prior and current chunk candidates by stable ascending distance; retain the best five distinct candidate entries with counts capped at five. Sum the first five original-reference distances by multiplicity and divide by five.
distance_execution.equivalence_argument: No chunk can contribute a global top-five reference beyond its five nearest distinct vectors; a sixth distinct vector is no closer than five vectors from that chunk. Equal-distance boundary ties have identical distances. Per-row multiplicities reproduce repeated original reference rows.
distance_execution.resume_state: Two disk-backed top-five distance/count state slots with per-reference-chunk atomic checkpoint.

resource_decision.rf_concurrency_rationale: The 2%-data two-worker sample improved pair throughput 1.74x, but full-data per-forest memory was not measured. Use one CIC worker to limit peak memory on the 12.07M-row source split.

label_use: CIC labels are source labels for this source-only gate. No UNSW labels or feature data are accessed.
randomness: No new random sampling is used by the distance implementation. RF and IsolationForest use their frozen run seed; all other transformations and calibration sub-splits follow the source config.
